HEADLINE: We refer to our earlier Letter No. CFPL/SEC/BSE/009/2026-2027 dated 29th October, 2026 informing you that the meeting of the Board of Directors is convened on Tuesday, 3rd November, 2026 ....
MORE:
We refer to our earlier Letter No. CFPL/SEC/BSE/009/2026-2027 dated 29th October, 2026 informing you that the meeting of the Board of Directors is convened on Tuesday, 3rd November, 2026 to consider amongst other business, the consideration of Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Financial Year ended on 30th September, 2026 along with the Statement of Assets and Liabilities as on 30th September, 2026 and Statement of Cash Flows for the Quarter and Half Financial Year ended 30th September, 2026.

Accordingly, the meeting of Board of Directors was held today in which the Board of Directors, have considered and taken on record the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter and Half Year ended on 30th September, 2026 along with the Statement of Assets and Liabilities as on 30th September, 2026 and Statement of Cash Flows for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026. The said Board Meeting was commenced at 04.45 P.M. and concluded at 05.30 P.M.
